title: Joby Aviation’s 3,100-mile autonomous flight signals its push beyond electric air taxis
summary: Last year, Joby signed an agreement with defense contractor L3Harris Technologies to “explore opportunities” to develop a new class of aircraft — specifically, a gas-turbine hybrid vertical take-off and landing aircraft that can fly autonomously — for defense applications.
